name: openboa-ai-native-sdlc
description: Help human and agent team members lead software outcomes with responsible autonomy, evidence, and continuity.

interface.longDescription: OpenBoa AI-Native SDLC helps humans delegate responsibly and helps human or agent work leads own outcomes with clear authority, sufficient resources, independent evidence, safe delivery, and continuity across sessions and environments.
defaultPrompt: Use $openboa-delegate-work to create a complete assignment for this outcome.
Use $openboa-lead-work to lead this assigned outcome with bounded autonomy.
Use $openboa-review-work to independently review the result and working system.
